instructions.title: Usage Guide
instructions.description: Review current ADDOM behavior, safety defaults, and workflow guidance.
instructions.note: Use this guide as a quick reference for how chat modes, approvals, memory, [[canon:artifacts]], and [[canon:moa]] currently behave.

projectFolder.title: Project Root Folder
projectFolder.description: Choose the active project root ADDOM uses for file tools and shell commands.

executionMode.title: Execution Mode
executionMode.description: Secondary surface for the default [[canon:ask]] / [[canon:autonomy]] / [[canon:full_access]] mode used by execute turns.

summary.ask: Execute turns continue normally for workspace-safe actions and pause when riskier network, install, or host-affecting steps need approval.
summary.autonomy: Execute turns can act inside workspace guardrails without routine confirmation. Hard blocks and out-of-scope actions still surface explicitly.
summary.fullAccess: Execute turns auto-approve tools for this session while explicit hard policy denies still block dangerous paths.

executionMode.notice: Execute turns use this saved default. Plan and Thinking mode keep the same default visible in chat but do not execute tools blindly.

assistantPrompt.title: Custom instructions
assistantPrompt.description: Add persistent guidance to each chat turn.
assistantPrompt.placeholder: Example: Prefer TypeScript. Keep code changes minimal and test-first. Do not use Tailwind.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the ADDOM app language for renderer UI surfaces only.
language.systemDefaultDescription: System default follows your OS language. Assistant replies, [[canon:backend]] behavior, commands, and technical tokens stay canonical English.
language.systemResolvedNotice: Your system language currently resolves to {{label}}. If that locale is not shipped yet, ADDOM falls back to English.
language.validationOnlyNotice: {{label}} is a validation locale. It stays hidden from normal release settings and should only be enabled during localization checks.
language.savedOnlyNotice: {{label}} is saved, but ADDOM currently ships English renderer strings only. The UI stays in English until that locale ships.

apiKeys.title: API Keys & Identities
apiKeys.description: Configure remote provider credentials and identities. Local providers like Ollama may not require keys.

cursor.runtimeMissing: Cursor Agent runtime is not installed.
cursor.executionScope: Composer 2.5 runs in Chat Execute with Full Access.
cursor.disconnectMessage: ADDOM will stop using this Cursor account until you reconnect. Your API key and project files are unchanged.
cursor.actionFailed: Cursor could not complete this action.

loginErrors.callbackPortInUse: The local OpenAI login callback port is already in use. Retry the login flow or close the conflicting process and try again.
loginErrors.consentDenied: The OpenAI browser consent step was cancelled or denied. Start the login flow again to retry.
loginErrors.callbackNotCompleted: The OpenAI browser sign-in did not complete the localhost callback. Retry the login flow and finish consent before returning to ADDOM.
loginErrors.browserOpenFailed: ADDOM could not open the OpenAI login page automatically. Use Open browser again or Copy login link.
loginErrors.missingAuthUrl: The OpenAI login link is no longer available. Start the login flow again to request a fresh browser link.
loginErrors.bridgeProcessExited: The local Codex runtime stopped while waiting for the OpenAI browser callback. Start the login flow again.
loginErrors.loginTimedOut: The OpenAI login flow timed out before the browser callback completed. Start the login flow again to retry.

account.waitingForCallback: Finish sign-in and consent in the browser, then return after the localhost callback completes.
account.waitingForBrowser: ADDOM is waiting for the browser login flow to begin.
account.notCompleted: OpenAI account login has not been completed yet.
account.storedKeyInactive: Stored API key remains available but inactive.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect OpenAI Account
disconnectDialog.message: Disconnect the stored OpenAI account session for this ADDOM profile?

copyFailed.title: Copy Failed
copyFailed.message: ADDOM could not copy the OpenAI account login link to the clipboard.

recommendedAccount.title: Recommended for OpenAI
recommendedAccount.description: OpenAI account is the primary production sign-in path. API key mode stays available as an alternate for direct API access.

chatTypography.title: Chat Text
chatTypography.description: Apply one global scale factor to the mapped chat text surfaces.
chatTypography.globalScaleDescription: This scales the mapped chat text tokens together. Per-element defaults stay outside Settings.
chatTypography.notice: The scale applies to the mapped text tokens already used across user messages, orchestrator output, agents, execution stream, and chat-adjacent cards.

uiScaling.description: Control ADDOM shell density and chat text scaling from one place.
uiScaling.appShellDensityDescription: [[canon:auto]] mode follows the effective viewport after OS scaling. [[canon:manual]] mode pins a shell density across displays.
uiScaling.autoModeDescription: [[canon:auto]] mode keeps the shell geometry aligned across 1080p and 4K setups by reacting to the actual CSS viewport.
uiScaling.manualModeDescription: [[canon:manual]] mode is useful if you want one fixed shell density regardless of display scaling.
uiScaling.shellScaleDescription: This scales the shell geometry tokens used by the sidebar, thread drawer, [[canon:moa]] rail, and chat content widths.
uiScaling.chatTypographyScaleDescription: Adjust chat text size alongside shell density so both layers can be tuned together.
uiScaling.notice: Anchored panels stay aligned because the shell widths and content rails scale from the same shared settings model instead of collapsing independently.

appearanceMode.description: Choose a light or dark interface, or follow your system setting.
appearanceMode.modeDescription: Updates the entire app, including editors and terminals.

backgroundTone.darkOnly: Workspace tones are available when the resolved theme is Dark.
backgroundTone.description: Choose a gray workspace tone. Graphite matches the current ADDOM default.
backgroundTone.toneDescription: Shifts the shared surface, panel, and border stack together.

commandSafety.title: Guardrails & Diagnostics
commandSafety.description: Hard guardrails stay on in all permission modes. [[canon:ask]], [[canon:autonomy]], and [[canon:full_access]] only change when approvals interrupt a turn.

riskyActionApprovals.title: Risky-action approvals
riskyActionApprovals.description: First risky network fetches and project dependency installs can be remembered for the active project during this app session. Outside-workspace paths, destructive actions, global installs, and elevated host access still require explicit approval.
riskyActionApprovals.noActiveWorkspace: No active workspace detected yet. Session-scoped risky-action memory starts once a project root is open.

modeEffect.title: Mode effect
modeEffect.description: [[canon:ask]] pauses on risky actions. [[canon:autonomy]] keeps routine workspace work moving and only interrupts on first risky network/install use or hard guardrail blocks. [[canon:full_access]] auto-approves routine execution while explicit hard-deny policy outcomes still block.

moaAgents.title: Agent roles
moaAgents.description: Create and manage the agent roles ADDOM can delegate work to.

roles.guidance: Role names must be unique. Role IDs are generated and immutable.
roles.openRouterRoutePlaceholder: Or enter a custom OpenRouter route ID
roles.instructionsPlaceholder: Optional instructions for this agent role (max 2000 chars)

runtime.title: Agent settings
runtime.description: Control delegation and capacity without changing your saved roles.
runtime.delegationEnabled: ADDOM can delegate work to the roles below.
runtime.delegationDisabled: Roles stay available to configure while delegation is off.
runtime.profileDescription: Sets sensible limits for parallel and nested agents.
runtime.isolationDescription: Agent file changes stay isolated until the orchestrator integrates them.

openRouterCatalogVisibility.title: OpenRouter Catalog Visibility
openRouterCatalogVisibility.description: Control which OpenRouter families and routes appear in chat and [[canon:moa]] browsing surfaces.
openRouterCatalogVisibility.notAvailable: OpenRouter is not available in the current provider manifest.
openRouterCatalogVisibility.browsingVisibilityDescription: Hide provider families or individual routes from browsing without removing explicit custom route support.
openRouterCatalogVisibility.searchPlaceholder: Search OpenRouter namespaces or route IDs
openRouterCatalogVisibility.empty: No OpenRouter routes match the current search.
openRouterCatalogVisibility.inlineDescription: Hide OpenRouter namespaces or routes from browsing without removing explicit route entry.

dataReset.title: Data Reset & Cleanup
dataReset.description: Transfer thread backups, manage credentials, or reset local ADDOM data.
dataReset.migrationDescription: Export your active chat directly to a portable JSON backup, or restore histories locally.
dataReset.noActiveConversation: No active conversation is selected to export.
dataReset.localProfileResetDescription: Remove saved provider keys, or fully reset ADDOM's local profile. A full reset deletes local history, cached models, attachments, and saved settings, then restarts the app.

providerBudget.title: Adaptive Provider Budgets
providerBudget.description: Inspect learned provider budget state and remove stale adaptive budget history without exposing raw provider headers or credential identities.
providerBudget.emptyState: No learned provider budget profiles have been recorded for this profile yet.

spillover.title: Tool Result Spillover
spillover.description: Inspect persisted tool result spillover storage, prune expired entries, and clear the spillover root without exposing raw output bodies.
spillover.sessionEmptyState: No spillover cleanup has run in this app session yet.
spillover.emptyState: No persisted tool result spillover files exist for this profile right now.

deleteApiKeys.title: Delete API Keys
deleteApiKeys.message: Delete all stored API keys from this device now? Conversations, memory, artifacts, and settings will remain. This cannot be undone.

cleanupProviderBudgets.title: Cleanup Learned Budgets
cleanupProviderBudgets.message: Delete invalid or long-unused expired learned provider budget profiles? Recent active profiles will remain.

resetProviderBudgets.title: Reset Learned Budgets
resetProviderBudgets.message: Delete all learned provider budget profiles from this profile? This removes adaptive budget history until new observations are recorded.

cleanupToolResultSpillover.title: Prune Spillover
cleanupToolResultSpillover.message: Prune expired or over-budget tool result spillover files from this profile? Recent spillovers needed by current retention policy will remain.

resetToolResultSpillover.title: Clear Spillover
resetToolResultSpillover.message: Delete all persisted tool result spillover files from this profile? This does not change retention policy and cannot be undone.

deleteAllLocalData.title: Delete All Local Data
deleteAllLocalData.message: Delete all ADDOM local data for this profile and restart? This removes API keys, conversations, memory logs, artifacts, project sessions, cached attachments, local model cache, and settings. Export anything you need first. This cannot be undone.

refreshFailed.title: Refresh Failed
refreshFailed.providerBudgetDefaultMessage: Unable to refresh learned provider budget summary.
refreshFailed.spilloverDefaultMessage: Unable to refresh tool result spillover summary.

apiKeysDeleted.title: API Keys Deleted
apiKeysDeleted.message: Stored API keys were deleted from this device.

feedback.refreshProviderBudgetFailed: Failed to refresh learned provider budgets: {{message}}
feedback.refreshToolResultSpilloverFailed: Failed to refresh tool result spillover: {{message}}
feedback.providerBudgetCleanupFailed: Failed to cleanup learned provider budgets: {{message}}
feedback.toolResultSpilloverCleanupFailed: Failed to prune tool result spillover: {{message}}
feedback.providerBudgetResetFailed: Failed to reset learned provider budgets: {{message}}
feedback.toolResultSpilloverResetFailed: Failed to clear tool result spillover: {{message}}

exportComplete.title: Export Complete
exportComplete.copiedMessage: Thread exported. JSON copied to clipboard and download started.
exportComplete.downloadMessage: Thread export created and download started.

exportPreflight.title: Compliance reminder before export
exportPreflight.description: Thread exports are portable. Do not use exports for prohibited distillation, benchmark harvesting, or provider-policy bypass workflows.
exportPreflight.preserveCitationsLabel: Preserve citations and attribution metadata in export
exportPreflight.preserveCitationsHint: Recommended for providers/models with attribution-sensitive terms.
exportPreflight.strictConfirmLabel: I confirm this export is for a terms-compliant workflow in this session.
exportPreflight.strictConfirmHint: Strict mode requires explicit confirmation before export.

importThread.title: Import thread JSON
importThread.description: Paste a previously exported thread payload to import it into the active project.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: ADDOM checks for updates automatically on launch. You control when updates are downloaded and installed.

status.error: Couldn't check for updates. Try again later.
status.errorUnavailable: The update service is not available yet. Try again later.
status.errorNetwork: Couldn't reach the update service. Check your connection and try again.
